description:
Former Blackrock Investment Advisor Ed Dowd and Insurance Analyst Josh Stirling discuss the date behind the excess deaths insurance companies are experiencing among their policy holders.Show more "In 2021, in ages 25-64, the employed people [in the US] covered under Group Life [insurance] experienced a 40% excess mortality. As quoted by the CEO of an insurance company, just a 10% increase in excess mortality is a "once in a 200-yr flood" so 40% is off the charts." -Ed Dowd, former Blackrock Investment Advisor
Sen. Ron Johnson Roundtable Discussion: Covid-19 Vaccines: What They Are, How They Work and Possible Causes of Injuries. December 7, 2022
